name: MitoEM 2.0
paper_notes: bioRxiv preprint (v3), PMC12927526; Liu, Shen, Wei et al. Code: https://github.com/luckieucas/MitoEM2.0
imaging: Mixed vEM: FIB-SEM (Beta, Jurkat, Macro, Podo, Sperm), ssSEM (Mossy, Pyra), SBF-SEM (Stem)

subvolumes.flag: UNVERIFIED z: paper table says 341 (avg), text says 1024x1024x512 with 3 training volumes

tissue_cell_type: pancreatic beta-cell, Jurkat T-cell, macrophage, cerebellar mossy fiber, kidney podocyte, cortical pyramidal neuron, spermatocyte, brainstem
file_formats: ZIP per dataset containing nnU-Net layout: NIfTI .nii.gz (image float32 single-channel, labels uint16), dataset.json, splits.json, metadata.csv, checksums
download_mechanism: Direct HTTPS GET from Zenodo API (no auth). md5 from Zenodo API.
notes: Zenodo record v3 (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17613832), CC-BY-4.0, published 2025-11-17. Voxel sizes/shapes come from the paper's dataset table (PMC12927526), not from the Zenodo record; the shapes are listed as averages. The paper DOI is not linked in the Zenodo metadata. The table and the text disagree on Sperm z (341 vs 512) and Stem xy (1000 vs 1024): check the NIfTI headers after download.

name: OrgSegNet / Plantorgan(elle) Hunter dataset
paper_notes: Feng et al., Nature Plants 2023, 9(10):1760-1775, 'Plantorganelle Hunter is an effective deep-learning-based method for plant organelle phenotyping in electron microscopy' (subscription). Code: https://github.com/yzy0102/OrgSegNet (README cites the older DOI prefix 10.11922/sciencedb.01335, which does not resolve at DataCite; 10.57760 is the live one).
organism: Oryza sativa (rice), per the dataset description. The paper's evaluation set covers 19 plant species; the deposit describes rice only.
labeled: Labeled - semantic masks for 4 classes (chloroplast, mitochondria, vacuole, nucleus). Labelme JSON in 'jsons' folder, PNG masks. Mask pixel values UNVERIFIED.
n_images: 673 images per description. The GitHub PrepareData.md lists splits of 541 train / 180 val / 181 test = 902, which conflicts.
file_formats: Original TIF (folder 'before'), downsized JPG copies, PNG masks, Labelme JSON ('jsons' folder)
download_mechanism: UNVERIFIED. Science Data Bank (scidb.cn) is a JS-rendered page. The API endpoints tried (sdb-dataset-service/dataset/details, gin-sdb-filetree childFileList) returned 404 or 'User Not Login'. Per-file names, md5s and direct URLs could not be retrieved. Downloading probably requires the web UI (a full-dataset zip or a per-file download button; a login may be required for bulk downloads). Inspect browser network requests on the landing page to get the real download endpoints.
files: UNVERIFIED - not retrievable via public API
notes: Metadata comes from the DataCite API (https://api.datacite.org/dois/10.57760/sciencedb.01335): 32.4 GB, 6,076 files, issued 2021-11-17, CSTR 31253.11.sciencedb.01335. Creators: Feng X., Liu F., Yu Z., Yang G., Chen L., Zhou X. Exceeds 30 GB.

name: DeepContact Training Data
paper_notes: Liu L., Yang S., Liu Y., Li X., Hu J., Xiao L., Xu T. 'DeepContact: High-throughput quantification of membrane contact sites based on electron microscopy imaging', J Cell Biol 2022 221(9):e202106190 (PMC9361564). Code: https://github.com/LX-doctorAI1/DeepContact. Models are in a companion figshare record, 10.6084/m9.figshare.19845940.
imaging: Serial ultrathin-section (70 nm) SEM with backscatter detector (FEI Helios Nanolab 600i) for U-2 OS and mouse seminiferous tubules, plus TEM (FEI Tecnai Spirit 120 kV) for COS-7. Mostly 2D.
xy_pixel_nm: 5 (U-2 OS SEM), 10 (Sertoli SEM), 4.68 (COS-7 TEM at 6800x). Model input is resized to 10 nm.
xy_dims_px: U-2 OS 3072 x 2048; Sertoli ~1024 x 1526; model patches 1024 x 1024; COS-7 TEM UNVERIFIED
z_voxel_nm: 2D (70 nm sections, but not analyzed as a volume)
organism: Homo sapiens (U-2 OS), Mus musculus (TM4 Sertoli line; CD-1 mouse seminiferous tubules), Chlorocebus (COS-7)
tissue_cell_type: U-2 OS osteosarcoma cells, TM4 Sertoli cells, COS-7 cells, mouse testis seminiferous epithelium (Sertoli cells)
labeled: Labeled - Labelme annotations of mitochondria, ER, lipid droplets (and plasma membrane for Sertoli), plus test data. Exact content per zip is UNVERIFIED.
file_formats: ZIP archives (inner formats UNVERIFIED; likely TIF/PNG images + Labelme JSON)
download_mechanism: Direct HTTPS GET via figshare ndownloader (follows redirect to S3). The md5 values are the figshare supplied_md5, which equals computed_md5.
notes: figshare article 19898404 v3. The record metadata gives no imaging details; those come from the JCB paper. Filenames contain spaces, so quote them in scripts.

name: TEM Mitochondria Segmentation Dataset for TNBC Chemotherapy Analysis (Zenodo 15602048)
paper_notes: bioRxiv preprint (PMC11870520), Echeverria lab (Baylor) / Zarringhalam (UMass Boston): 'Artificial intelligence-enabled automated analysis of transmission electron micrographs to evaluate chemotherapy impact on mitochondrial morphology in triple negative breast cancer'. Code: https://github.com/umbibio/tem-seg-reproducibility , https://github.com/umbibio/tem-seg ; models are in Zenodo 15602446.
xy_pixel_nm: UNVERIFIED (bioRxiv full text was rate-limited; images are 'calibrated' per tem-seg docs)
organism: Human TNBC patient-derived xenografts grown in mice (orthotopic PDX), plus adherent cell cultures; Drp1-KO set likely mouse primary skeletal muscle cells (UNVERIFIED mapping)
tissue_cell_type: TNBC mammary tumors (PDX models HCI-010, PIM001-P), matched lung metastases, cultured cells, DRP1-KO cells
labeled: Labeled - binary semantic mitochondria masks (PNG). 125 micrographs with 11,039 annotated mitochondria (per abstract).
file_formats: tar.gz containing TIFF slide images; tar.gz containing PNG single-channel masks (per tem-seg docs). Subsets: DRP1-KO, HCI-010, Mixture, PIM001-P.
download_mechanism: Direct HTTPS GET from Zenodo API (no auth). Alternatively run 'bash scripts/download_images.sh' in the tem-seg-reproducibility repo.
notes: Version 1.0.0, published 2025-06-05, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15602047. Pixel size and image dimensions are NOT in the Zenodo record or the GitHub docs; read them from the TIFF tags after download or from the preprint methods.

name: Cardiomyocyte TEM / MitoMapper images (Zenodo 17068504)

paper_notes: Creator: Medical University of Graz, University Heart Center Graz. Tool: https://github.com/JGHMicroscopy/MitoMapper (ImageJ/Fiji macro).
xy_dims_px: UNVERIFIED (TIFFs are 22-133 MB each, so large montages are likely)

name: Platynereis dumerilii 6 dpf whole-body SBEM (PlatyBrowser; Vergara et al.)
paper_notes: Vergara, Pape et al., 'Whole-body integration of gene expression and single-cell morphology', Cell 2021 (preprint 10.1101/2020.02.26.961037). The paper DOI is not given in the Zenodo record and was filled in from prior knowledge, so treat it as UNVERIFIED in this session. Project: https://github.com/mobie/platybrowser-project

components.description: CNN training blocks (Zenodo 3675220, 'Platynereis EM training data', C. Pape)
components.inner_format: UNVERIFIED (ZIPs, probably HDF5/n5 raw+label pairs; see github.com/platybrowser/platybrowser-backend segmentation folder)

components.description: Full raw SBEM volume served for MoBIE/PlatyBrowser (BDV-N5 on EMBL S3)
components.s3_signing_region: us-west-2 (from the XML; anonymous public read works)
components.http_note: Verified: <root>/attributes.json, <root>/setup0/attributes.json and <root>/setup0/timepoint0/s0/attributes.json are fetchable anonymously at buckets.embl.de. The same paths at s3.embl.de returned 403.
components.format: N5 (BDV-N5 layout: setup0/timepoint0/s{0..9}), uint8, gzip level 5, blockSize [96,96,96] (verified for s0 and s3)
components.chunk_url_pattern: https://buckets.embl.de/platybrowser-n5-generic/platybrowser/rawdata/sbem-6dpf-1-whole-raw.n5/setup0/timepoint0/s{L}/{bx}/{by}/{bz}  (standard N5 block path, x/y/z block indices; individual block fetch UNVERIFIED; empty blocks may be absent)
components.access_tools: zarr/z5py/tensorstore (n5 driver over HTTP), or s3fs/boto3 with endpoint_url=https://buckets.embl.de and anon=True, or MoBIE in Fiji
components.uncompressed_size_note: s0 is about 8.1 TB uncompressed uint8 (27499*25916*11416). Total compressed size on S3 is UNVERIFIED (no bucket listing obtained). A full pyramid adds about 15% more.
components.labeled: Raw only (segmentations are separate N5 sources in the same project)

tissue_cell_type: whole body, 6 days post fertilization larva
labeled: Zenodo training data: labeled (cell membranes/boundaries, cilia, cuticle, nuclei). S3 raw volume: unlabeled raw EM (segmentations available separately in the project).
total_size_gb: 6.76 (Zenodo training data); raw S3 volume about 8.1 TB uncompressed at s0 (compressed size UNVERIFIED)
file_formats: Zenodo: ZIP; raw: N5 (BDV-N5), gzip, uint8, 96^3 blocks, 10 scale levels
download_mechanism: Zenodo: direct HTTPS GET. Raw: anonymous S3/HTTP reads from buckets.embl.de bucket platybrowser-n5-generic, key platybrowser/rawdata/sbem-6dpf-1-whole-raw.n5. Download a downsampled level (for example s3 at 80x80x100 nm, about 32 GB uncompressed) or crop ROIs instead of the full s0.
notes: The Zenodo DOI given (3675220) is only the CNN training data (6.76 GB), not the full atlas. The raw atlas location comes from the MoBIE project XML (v1.0.1) and was checked live. s1/s2/s4-s9 shapes are computed as ceil(s0/factor), consistent with the verified s3 shape.

name: S-BIAD2822 NucleoNet nuclei instance segmentation (AT-SEM + FIB-SEM)
paper_notes: bioRxiv 2026-04-05: Bhardwaj, Dell, Mikolaj, Spiers, Harned, Kuppusamy, Liu, Wei, Sterneck, Narayan. 'NucleoNet and DropNet: Generalist deep learning models for instance segmentation of nuclei and lipid droplets from electron microscopy images'. Models are in the empanada v1.2 napari plugin.
imaging: Array tomography SEM (2D sections, Zeiss SEM450) for id_1-id_10; FIB-SEM (Zeiss Crossbeam 550) for id_11-id_12
tissue_cell_type: breast cancer cells (SUM149, MDA-MB-231), mouse lung tumor, mouse 4T1 mammary carcinoma cells
labeled: Labeled - 2D nucleus instance masks (NucleoNet prediction + expert proofreading in empanada-napari) for id_1-id_10; 3D single-nucleus masks for id_11/id_12. Edge nuclei were removed for most images (id_8 and id_10 include them).
file_formats: TIFF (.tif/.tiff); label TIFF instance masks; file lists as JSON/TSV
download_mechanism: Direct HTTPS from the EBI FTP mirror: https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/fire/S-BIAD/822/S-BIAD2822/Files/<path> (e.g. .../Files/id_1/img_2bf732c1.tif). Also ftp://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/fire/S-BIAD/822/S-BIAD2822/Files/ and Globus (origin_id 47772002-3e5b-4fd3-b97c-18cee38d6df2, path /biostudies/fire/S-BIAD/822/S-BIAD2822). No md5 given in the file lists.
files: See subvolumes (image + label paths relative to files_base_url, sizes in bytes from the BioStudies file-list JSONs). Metadata lists: file_list_images_1.json, file_list_images_2_v2.json, file_list_images_3.json, file_list_images_4.json, file_list_annotations_1.json, file_list_annotations_2.json (+ .tsv).
notes: Released 2026-02-03, modified 2026-04-30. 24 data files (12 images + 12 labels). The id_11/id_12 FIB-SEM TIFFs (~180 MB) are smaller than uint8 dims would imply (~1.26 GB for id_11), so they are probably compressed TIFFs; check after download. Total = 1,912,836,168 (images) + 42,094,004 (labels) bytes. The BioStudies /info endpoint gives no size field, so the total was summed from the file lists.
